eval_dimensions.name: Coordinators Only
eval_dimensions.description: Global mode prompts only each repository's coordinator; repo mode prompts only its own repository's worktree sessions.

eval_dimensions.name: Never Type Over Someone
eval_dimensions.description: Every prompt follows a herdr agent get + read check; working, blocked or typed-into panes are never prompted, and no clearing keys are sent.

eval_dimensions.name: Brief and Status Files
eval_dimensions.description: Briefs are written to files in the round directory and the prompt only points at them; replies are read from status files ending in a status token.

eval_dimensions.name: No-Coordinator Gate
eval_dimensions.description: A repository with worktree sessions but no main session triggers AskUserQuestion with exactly one Recommended option, first, computed from the sessions' states.

eval_dimensions.name: Status Only
eval_dimensions.description: A blocked session's question is reported, never answered or relayed.

assertions.signal: The skill says it is not running inside Herdr and makes no herdr_roster or herdr agent call

evals.name: Global round reaches repositories through their main sessions
evals.description: Caller role is outside. herdr_roster lists tt-pos with coordinator wX:p1 (idle) and two worktree sessions, and tt-dvi with coordinator wQ:p1 (done) and one worktree session.

assertions.signal: herdr agent prompt is sent to wX:p1 and wQ:p1 only, each as a run_in_background call
brief-tt-pos.md and brief-tt-dvi.md are written before the prompts, each naming a status file and /dev10x-herdr:mission-control in repo mode
herdr agent get and herdr agent read --source visible run for each coordinator before its prompt

evals.name: Repo round reads busy worktrees instead of prompting them
evals.description: Caller role is main for tt-pos. Worktree sessions: wB8:p1 working, w3Q:p1 blocked on an approval, wC5:p1 done.
evals.input: /dev10x-herdr:mission-control what is left before your PR merges?

assertions.signal: herdr agent prompt is sent only to wC5:p1
wB8:p1 is summarised from herdr agent read output; no keys are sent to any pane
w3Q:p1 is reported as waiting on the supervisor with its visible question; the skill does not answer it

evals.name: Repository without a main session asks the supervisor
evals.description: Global mode. tt-k8s has worktree sessions w5M:p1 (idle) and wAZ:p1 (working) and no coordinator.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion names tt-k8s and its sessions; 'Ask worktrees directly (Recommended)' is the first option because w5M:p1 is idle
No tt-k8s session is prompted before the supervisor answers the gate

evals.name: A reply without a status token is not treated as done
evals.description: The wait for wX:p1 exits with state done, but status-tt-pos.md is missing.

assertions.signal: The report marks tt-pos NEEDS_CONTEXT, reads the pane, and resends at most once
